tool.name: sincei scCountQC
tool.description: quality metrics and filtering of a count matrix
tool.command: scCountQC --input '$input' #if str($mode.operation) == 'metrics': --outMetrics qc #else: --outFile '$filtered' ## build 'metric: min, max; metric: min, max'. An empty max becomes inf: with a single value, ## sincei 0.6.1 looks up cell metrics in adata.var instead of adata.obs and fails. #if $mode.cell_filters: #set $cell_args = [] #for $f in $mode.cell_filters #set $fmax = str($f.max) if str($f.max) not in ('', 'None') else 'inf' #silent $cell_args.append('%s: %s, %s' % ($f.metric, $f.min, $fmax)) #end for --filterCellArgs '#echo '; '.join($cell_args)#' #end if #if $mode.region_filters: #set $region_args = [] #for $f in $mode.region_filters #set $fmax = str($f.max) if str($f.max) not in ('', 'None') else 'inf' #silent $region_args.append('%s: %s, %s' % ($f.metric, $f.min, $fmax)) #end for --filterRegionArgs '#echo '; '.join($region_args)#' #end if #if $mode.region_blacklist: --region_blacklist #for $bl in $mode.region_blacklist '$bl' #end for #end if #if str($mode.chrom_blacklist).strip(): --chrom_blacklist #for $chrom in str($mode.chrom_blacklist).split(',') #if $chrom.strip() '${chrom.strip()}' #end if #end for #end if #end if

repeat.name: cell_filters
repeat.title: Cell filter
repeat.help: List of arguments to filter cells. Cells with a QC metric outside [minimum, maximum] are removed. Run 'Compute QC metrics' first to view all available metrics.

param.name: max
param.label: Maximum value
param.help: Leave empty for no upper bound.

repeat.name: region_filters
repeat.title: Region filter
repeat.help: List of arguments to filter regions. Regions with a QC metric outside [minimum, maximum] are removed. Run 'Compute QC metrics' first to view all available metrics.

param.name: max
param.label: Maximum value
param.help: Leave empty for no upper bound.

param.label: Region blacklist
param.help: A BED or GTF file containing regions that should be excluded from all analyses. Regions in the AnnData object that overlap with blacklisted regions will be removed.

param.label: Chromosome blacklist
param.help: A list of chromosomes to exclude, separated by commas, e.g. chrM,chrUn.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scCountQC` computes quality metrics for the cells and regions of a count matrix produced by `scCountReads`, such as total counts, the number of detected regions per cell, and dropout rates.
- **Compute QC metrics** writes the per-cell and per-region metrics as tables. - **Filter cells and regions** removes cells and regions outside the given metric ranges, plus blacklisted regions or chromosomes, and returns a filtered count matrix.
Each cell or region filter keeps only the cells/regions whose QC metric lies between the given minimum and maximum (inclusive). Several filters can be combined. Run **Compute QC metrics** first to see the metric values.
-----
**Inputs**
- An AnnData (`h5ad`) count matrix from sincei.
**Outputs**
- *Compute QC metrics*: a cell metrics table and a region metrics table. - *Filter cells and regions*: a filtered AnnData (`h5ad`) object. @HELP_FOOTER@
